patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-definition video and image sections dominate the page, creating an immersive, cinematic experience that unfolds vertically.
Headings use an elegant, widely-spaced sans-serif, often in uppercase, contrasting with smaller, highly legible body text and subtle uppercase labels.
A sophisticated dark palette of deep browns, charcoals, and black serves as a backdrop for crisp white text, with minimal, precise accents of red and bronze from branding elements.
As the user scrolls, new full-bleed video or image sections reveal sequentially, often accompanied by text overlays and call-to-action buttons that fade or slide into view over the media.
Content is organized into distinct, full-screen media-rich sections, with a dedicated 'Explore Further' section presenting three equal-width content cards.

technique_notes: The site uses full-bleed video and image backgrounds for primary content sections, with text and interactive elements overlaid centrally. These sections are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls, often with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation for the overlaid content, creating a dynamic, unfolding narrative. The initial hero is a looping video. This scroll-triggered reveal system is likely implemented using JavaScript for scroll detection and CSS keyframes for the element animations.

Typography is handled with a clear hierarchy: large, elegant sans-serifs for titles with generous letter-spacing, and a smaller, clean sans-serif for body text. Text overlays on dark media backgrounds use white for high contrast.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized elegant headings with generous letter spacing, paired with smaller, highly legible body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: sharp for most elements, subtle rounding for interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: airy overall, with generous vertical spacing between full-bleed sections, creating a sense of grandeur; content within cards is more balanced.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its immersive, cinematic presentation, utilizing full-bleed, high-definition video and photography as primary content sections that unfold sequentially. This creates a highly emotional and luxurious user journey, rather than a typical static page layout, making the browsing experience feel like an interactive film.
